channel.title: Arnav Giri | Projects & Tools
channel.description: Portfolio updates and useful web tools built by Arnav Giri.

item.title: Free QR Code Generator
item.description: Create a free QR code for any URL or text. Customize colors, size and error correction, then download a crisp PNG or SVG. Private, no sign-up and entirely browser-based.

item.title: Password Generator
item.description: Free secure password generator. Create strong random passwords with custom length, uppercase, numbers and symbols. Cryptographically random, private and browser-based.

item.title: Age Calculator — Exact Age in Years, Months and Days
item.description: Calculate your age by date of birth today or on any cut-off date, see total days lived and next birthday countdown.

item.title: Typing Speed Test — Free Typing Practice
item.description: Measure words per minute, accuracy, and mistakes with 30-, 60-, and 120-second typing tests.

item.title: Study Ambient Sounds — Free Sound Mixer
item.description: Mix rain, forest, fan, wind, white noise, and thunder with adjustable volume controls and a sleep timer.

item.title: Study Focus Timer — Free Study Tool
item.description: Stay focused with a distraction-free study timer, custom durations, fullscreen mode, and calming themes.
